freeze_note: Date denotes the protocol day, not a measured clock time. File bytes and SHA-256 will be recorded before any trajectory target computation. Earlier source prices and the previous correlation-change research were already inspected.
research_status: EXPLORATORY retrospective development; no fresh holdout claim for history through September 2026
prices_and_windows: Positive finite closes; arithmetic returns without filling. Gap-spanning returns missing unless adjacent UTC labels differ by exactly one day. Each graph requires every fixed identity complete and sample SD>1e-12. No changing nodes. Missing/invalid windows remain excluded and counted.
graph: Common-sample Pearson C; W=max(C,0), diagonal zero; L=diag(W1)-W; ascending ordinary spectrum, lambda2=second eigenvalue (zero for disconnected support).
target: delta_W(t)=lambda2_W(t+20)-lambda2_W(t); both endpoint graph windows must be complete on the same ten identities. The two graph windows share W-20 returns when W>20; this mechanical overlap is explicit. No future returns enter predictors.

predictors.persistence: Predict delta=0; direction probabilities from the same earlier rolling calibration errors, not probability one on flat.
predictors.known_window_components: For W=60, retained latest40 and outgoing earliest20 returns are already known at t. For other W use retained W-20 and outgoing20; W=20 has no retained sample. Each usable subwindow contributes lambda2, mean Pearson and basket annualized SD. These features are shared by all ridge variants, rather than only awarded to the trajectory model.
predictors.trajectory20: Current + known components + lambda2 endpoint difference, mean minus current, sample SD and least-squares slope across the last20 graph endpoints, including current; require all20 endpoints usable.
predictors.trajectory60: Same as trajectory20 but use the last60 graph endpoints; require all60 usable. Current-only and trajectory variants are compared on the common eligible dates.
predictors.excluded: No next20 observations, target graph, future label, news or filings without verified publication time. SEC/news collection is a later separate stage requiring official as-of timestamps.

model.method: Ridge linear regression with unpenalized intercept; objective=sum((y-intercept-Xbeta)^2)+alpha*sum(beta^2)
model.transforms: Training-only feature medians, missingness flags for partly missing training columns, population mean/SD; drop constant expanded columns. Source prices/returns are never imputed.
model.coefficient_refit: After inner alpha selection, refit on all matured history available strictly before the forecast-block origin; each refit learns its transforms only from that history.

chronology.common_schedule: Start only once the largest W120 graph has60 past graph endpoints. Stop retrospective as-of dates at the frozen retrospective source cutoff minus20 observations. Boundaries use scheduled dates, not performance or target extrema.
chronology.outer_test: Final20% of the common scheduled as-of span; expanding walk-forward forecast blocks of20 consecutive scheduled dates. All earlier history is development, not an uninspected test.
chronology.maturity: At any forecast/calibration block origin position b, training label endpoint position i must satisfy i+20<b. Purge the20 immediately preceding as-of endpoints. Earlier fully realized training windows may overlap each other and the predictor history; disclose dependence.
chronology.inner_tuning: For each outer origin, first60% of matured scheduled history is fitting, next20% tunes alpha, final20% is reserved for honest rolling calibration. Purge20 before tuning and20 before calibration. Select alpha by tuning MAE, tie to larger alpha.
chronology.rolling_calibration: With alpha fixed from the earlier inner tuning period, forecast reserved calibration dates in20-date blocks. At each calibration origin fit only labels satisfying i+20<origin. Keep residuals only once their labels are matured before the outer origin. No in-sample residuals or test residuals calibrate their own forecasts.
chronology.secondary_W_selection: Select W and ridge variant using earlier tuning MAE divided by the same-W persistence MAE, common eligible dates; tie to W60, then larger W, then current-only and larger alpha. W changes the target itself, so selected-W results stay separate from primary W60 conclusions.
chronology.latest_projection: Use the newest complete fixed-cohort as-of available from the bounded source refresh; train only labels matured strictly before that origin. Future20 target is pending and must not be assigned an outcome or scored. All earlier dates remain retrospectively exploratory.

probabilities_and_intervals.material_band: For each W, band=0.5*sampleSD(delta) on the fitting segment at the initial outer origin; freeze that numeric band for all outer evaluations of that W. Labels: down if delta<-band, up if delta>band, otherwise flat. This band is a research definition, not an economic significance guarantee.
probabilities_and_intervals.probabilities: Empirical earlier rolling calibration residual CDF, shifted by each point prediction; Laplace one-count smoothing per down/flat/up category. These are approximate predictive class probabilities, never forced Gamma fits.
probabilities_and_intervals.nominal_90_interval: Point prediction plus5th/95th percentiles of honest earlier rolling calibration residuals; source residuals are dependent, so nominal90 coverage is not guaranteed. Evaluate interval coverage on outer forecasts. Separately report60-observation moving-block sensitivity of residual quantiles.
probabilities_and_intervals.latest_baseline: Always show zero-change persistence beside the newest model projection; no price direction or trade recommendation.

grading.primary: Paired MAE on identical eligible W60 outer dates; RMSE supplemental. Compare persistence, current+known components, trajectory20 and trajectory60.
grading.direction: Three-class Brier=sum_k(p_k-y_k)^2 (range0..2); classwise fixed-bin calibration. Assess against empirical-calibrated persistence, not raw classification accuracy alone.
grading.uncertainty: Paired circular moving-block bootstrap of fixed outer-forecast absolute-loss differences, block60,2000 replicates, seed20261015; conditional on this development protocol and fitted history, not a proof of stationarity or fresh validation.
grading.nonoverlap: Every20th scheduled eligible forecast date for all20 offsets; report all phases and counts, no favorable phase selected. Endpoint graph targets still share returns when W>20, even when forward20 innovations do not overlap.
grading.failure_reporting: Report failures, missing eligibility, calibration gaps and intervals covering zero plainly. No trajectory advantage or calibrated probability claim unless supported by the saved comparisons; all retrospective findings remain exploratory.
